d: We’re a fast-growing regional consumer e-commerce brand operating across the GCC and the UK. We’re looking for someone to own our marketing in Bahrain and make the market feel like home turf.
If you know what’s trending in Manama before it hits your feed, read on.
q: 3 to 5 years in marketing execution, with real in-market experience in Bahrain or the GCC
Fluent Arabic and English; you can tell when a caption reads Bahraini and when it doesn’t
Hands-on experience running influencer programs and brand partnerships
Comfortable with data: you track ROI, read the numbers and act on them
A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or a related field
r: Own the local marketing plan for Bahrain and deliver it across the biggest seasonal moments of the year
Adapt regional campaigns so they land locally, with the right tone, dialect and cultural cues, without losing the brand
Build and manage the influencer and creator roster on the platforms Bahrainis actually use
Lead local partnerships, sponsorships and activations from brief to results
Run the weekly performance review, spot what’s off and fix it within the week
Write sharp campaign briefs and manage spend against budget
Keep all advertising and influencer work compliant with local regulations
Coach junior marketers and work closely with central creative, campaign and channel teams
Real ownership of a market, not a slice of someone else’s plan
A brand people know and come back to
Room to test ideas, move fast and see the impact
A regional team that shares what works across markets
